<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/credit_holds"}
#docs
Refused with 402 and a `code`: `in_flight_limit` when open holds would pass the business's share of the balance, `insufficient_credit` when the customer's policy blocks and the amount is more than is available. A hold that is not captured or released expires after `expires_in` seconds (default: the business's hold time, 60). Needs `credit_holds:manage`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | **yes** | The estimated cost, more than 0. |
| `currency` | `string` | no | ISO 4217. Default: the customer's currency. |
| `meter` | `string` | no | The meter the call will use. |
| `scope` | `object` | no | Up to 10 usage property values, stored for scoped spend limits. |
| `expires_in` | `integer` | no | Seconds, 1 to 86,400. Default: the business's hold time (60). |
| `metadata` | `object` | no | Key-value pairs you attach to the credit hold. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `credit_hold`. One of `credit_hold`. |
| `id` | `string` | chd_… |
| `customer` | `string` | cus_… |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | The amount held. |
| `meter` | `string` | The meter's id. |
| `scope` | `object` | Usage property values, for scoped spend limits. |
| `status` | `string` | The credit hold's status. One of `held`, `captured`, `released`, `expired`. |
| `expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit hold expires (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `captured_minor` | `integer` | The rated value of the captured usage event. |
| `overdraft` | `boolean` | The captured usage took the balance past the overdraft limit. |
| `metadata` | `object` | Key-value pairs you attach to the credit hold. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit hold was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit hold was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | The open hold. |
| `400` | The body is not correct. |
| `402` | Refused: `in_flight_limit` or `insufficient_credit`. |
| `404` | No such customer or meter. |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/credit_holds" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "amount_minor": 2900,
    "currency": "USD"
  }'
```
